Maleka Khan’s tale of 1971 (Part-2)
2016-12-17T19:18:57+06:00 | Khalid Hussain Ayon
https://www.thedailystar.net/video-stories/watch-now-maleka-khanss-1971-part-2-1331332

Maleka Khan, the former organising secretary of Bangladesh Girl Guides Association, tells her experience of the 1971 Liberation War.

In this episode, Maleka Khan shared how and what she saw in the torture cell of Nakhal Para MP Hostel after the war end. She also tells how she was involved with women's rehabilitation and started working with renowned poet Begum Sufia Kamal.

Watch out for more of her upcoming interviews where she sheds light on how she dealt with the rape victims after the war as a director of Bangladesh Central Women's Rehabilitation Centre. Also WATCH: Part I
